description: Revert to the proven stable 10-layer configuration with verified hyperparameters (Matrix LR 0.06, Embedding LR 1.5, Total Batch 2^18, Weight Decay 0.1) and Device Batch Size 128 to maximize the probability of a crash-free run and achieve the best known val_bpb of 0.9777, as all recent modifications have resulted in instability or worse results.
